# Draft:List of Fictional Presidencies of US Presidents

The following is a list of Presidents of the United States who in a historical fiction or otherwise fictional setting, served in a presidency at a different time or under different circumstances.
George Washington
*In The Two Georges by Harry Turtledove and Richard Dreyfuss, George Washington was able to meet with King George III and ultimately avoided the American Revolution. Washington became governor-general of the North American Union.
John Adams
Thomas Jefferson
James Maddison
James Monroe
John Quincy Adams
*In The Disunited States of America by Harry Turtledove, an alternate history where several states become independent is featured with John Quincy Adams becoming the head of Massachusetts and Rhode Island.
*In Heartfire by Orson Scott Card, John Quincy Adams was mentioned as being the Governor of Massachusetts.

Richard Nixon
*In  The Psychotechnic League by Poul Anderson, Richard Nixon became the 35th president after Dwight D. Eisenhower died due to surgical complications. This lead to worldwide nuclear war.
*In Making History by Stephen Fry, Richard Nixon was mentioned as being elected in 1960, 1964, and 1968.
*In Watchmen by Alan Moore and Dave Gibbons, Richard Nixon was on his fifth term as president in 1985 and eventually became the fifth president to be carved into Mount Rushmore.
*In Dark Future by Kim Newman, Richard Nixon defeated John F. Kennedy in the 1960 presidential election.
*In Back to the Future Part II, in an alternate timeline, it is stated that Richard Nixon intends to run for a fifth term in 1984.
*In "Heavy Metal" by Barry N. Malzberg, Richard Nixon won the 1960 presidential election.
Gerald Ford
Jimmy Carter
Ronald Reagan
George H. W. Bush
*In The White House Mess by Christopher Buckley, George H. W. Bush won the 1992 presidential election after losing the 1988 presidential election.
*In Einstein's Bridge by John G. Cramer, George H. W. Bush served two full terms and built the Superconducting Super Collider which lead to extraterrestrials colonizing Earth, so two time travelers go back in time to change the election results.
*In Copper Cops by Rick Mackin, it is mentioned that Bush serves two terms.
Bill Clinton
George W. Bush
Barack Obama
Donald Trump
Joe Biden
*In The Last Ship'', it is implied the Joe Biden briefly served as President after Barack Obama succumbed to the Red Flu. He also succumbed to the virus one week later
